title: Mine lava bed never plays: theme 'feat' is an Array but Ambience compares str(feat) == 'lava'
repro: Mine floor with theme Magma Rifts / Obsidian Halls (mine.gd THEMES feat: ["lava"]). ambience.gd:208-211 does str(th.get('feat','')) == 'lava' -> '["lava"]' != 'lava', so out['lava'] is never set; only the generic cave drone plays beside visible lava pools. Confirmed headless: tools/probe_c6_07_lava.gd sets mine theme {cave: stone, feat: [lava]} -> _evaluate() = {cave: -14} only.
fix: var feat: Array = th.get('feat', []) if th.get('feat') is Array else [str(th.get('feat',''))]; if 'lava' in feat: lava -14; elif 'crystals' in feat or 'crystal' in str(th.get('cave','')): crystal_hum. Also add a water-feat bed (water_lap -22 or basement_drips -20) for Mossy Hollows / Flooded Galleries / Frost Caves / Drowned Dark (feat 'water'), since has_sky=false skips the outdoor water_lap path.

title: Region 'amb' lists put wind and town/city hum inside caves (frost_caverns, desert_sunken_temple wind; gilt_vaults town_day; iron_tunnels city_hum)
repro: regions.json (from gen_mega_new.py): frost_caverns amb {wind_soft -12, cave, crystal_hum}; desert_sunken_temple {wind_soft -13, cave}; gilt_vaults {town_day -20, cave, basement_drips}; iron_tunnels {city_hum -19, machines, cave, basement_drips}. ambience.gd:249-259 only drops WILD_BEDS for quiet maps, so a surface wind/street bed plays underground (the hard-coded path already avoids wind in caves via `deep`). Confirmed by probe: frost_caverns {cave, crystal_hum, wind_soft -12} at every time; gilt_vaults town_day -20; iron_tunnels city_hum -19; desert_sunken_temple wind_soft -13.
fix: In gen_mega_new.py give cave areas their own amb (cave, drips, crystal_hum, lava/machines as fits) instead of the region-wide list; and in ambience.gd skip SURFACE_BEDS = [wind_soft, wind_strong, town_day, crowd, city_hum, neon_street, rain_*, birds_*, leaves] from the region list when is_cave(m).

title: Region 'amb' beds ignore time, season and weather: crickets at noon and in winter (Gloamwood, Hollow Deeps), frogs in winter/daytime (gloam_moonpool), birds_day in rain/winter (gilt_gardens)
repro: gloam_* areas have amb {crickets -15, ...} and no season; ambience.gd:251-259 copies every amb bed straight in, only skipping birds at 'night'. So crickets play at 12:00 in a winter snowstorm, gloam_moonpool frogs play all day in winter, gilt_gardens birds_day plays in rain and winter. The hard-coded wildlife rules (lines 161-168) gate all of these by phase/season/wet. Confirmed by probe: gloam_moonpool day 94 (winter) snow 12:00 -> crickets -15, frogs -18, marsh, wind; gilt_gardens rain 12:00 -> birds_day -16 + rain_light.
fix: Run region wildlife beds through the same gates as the built-in ones: crickets only dusk/night spring-fall not wet (or allow an explicit 'always_night' region flag for Gloamwood's eternal-dusk feel, but never in winter/snow), frogs night spring/summer, birds_* not wet/snowy and not winter except dawn chirps. A small helper _wild_ok(bed, ph, se, wet, snowy) used by both paths.

title: Battlefields (bf_*) get no themed ambience: birds/crickets on the space station deck, ash wastes and sewer works; no sea on reef/kelp fields, no city on rail yards/uptown plaza, no wind on highland pass/cloud stair
repro: regions.json bf_* entries have no amb/quiet/cave keys and only bf_dockside, bf_neon_block, bf_bog_crossing are in the hard-coded lists. bf_station_deck, bf_ash_wastes, bf_sewer_works (light 0.6, underground) are not in QUIET_MAPS, so wild=true -> birds_day by day, crickets by night. bf_reef_shallows/bf_kelp_beds are not SEA_MAPS (no waves/gulls); bf_rail_yards/bf_uptown_plaza get no city bed; bf_highland_pass/bf_cloud_stair/bf_frostfield no wind outside winter; bf_jungle_grove no jungle_insects; bf_river_ford no river. Confirmed with tools/probe_c6_07_amb.gd: bf_station_deck/bf_sewer_works/bf_ash_wastes noon = birds_day -16, 23:00 = crickets -18, rain = rain_light (sewer is underground); bf_reef_shallows/bf_rail_yards same, no sea/city bed.
fix: Have gen_battles.py write amb / quiet / cave into each bf_ regions.json entry from bf_themes.FIELDS (e.g. a per-family AMB map: station -> space+machines quiet, ash -> wind_soft quiet, sewer -> cave+basement_drips cave:true, reef/kelp -> waves, rail/uptown -> city_hum, highland/cloud -> wind_soft, jungle -> jungle_insects, river -> river, frost -> wind_soft+season winter). Ambience already honours these keys.

title: Several beds are 0.4-3 s files looped: audible stutter (machines 0.39 s, birds_dawn 1.32 s, campfire 1.44 s, boiling 2.4 s, wind_strong 3.0 s, purr_loop 2.8 s, waves 4.2 s, marsh 6.2 s, crickets 6.5 s)
repro: ffprobe audio/amb/*.ogg. birds_dawn (every wild map at dawn) repeats the same 1.3 s chirp phrase ~45x a minute; machines (smith/forge interiors, Ironline areas) repeats a 0.4 s cycle 2.5x/s with a 0.26 sample jump at the seam (click every loop); campfire (festival night, community farm dusk, Frost Hearthhold, Mirage Post) is a 1.4 s crackle loop.
fix: In cc0_import.py, build beds to >= 20-30 s: concatenate several source files / random-offset crossfaded slices (e.g. 6-10 s chunks with 0.5 s equal-power crossfades, random order) and finish with a crossfaded seamless loop point; for birds_dawn use the whole bird-chirping pack, for campfire fire-1..N, for machines the 30-cc0-sfx-loops machine_* set. Re-run tools/sfx_soften.py on the new files.
audio_needed: Longer source material if the CC0 packs are too short (dawn chorus, campfire, forge/machine room, strong wind): 30-60 s CC0 recordings or ACE-free CC0 from OpenGameArt/freesound CC0.

title: Loop-seam clicks in long beds: frogs (jump 0.16), hearth (0.16), wind_soft (0.14), rain_light (0.09), river (0.09), basement_drips (0.09, tail 13 dB quieter than head)
repro: Decode audio/amb/<bed>.ogg and compare the last sample to the first: |a[-1]-a[0]| = frogs .164, hearth .159, wind_soft .142, rain_light .094, river .091, basement_drips .088 (head -28 dB, tail -41 dB). Ambience loops them (AudioStreamOggVorbis.loop = true), so a click/step is heard every 15-43 s; wind_soft is the most-used bed (14 region lists + winter + windy maps).
fix: Make loops seamless at import: crossfade the last 0.5-1 s into the first (tail-into-head overlap, then trim) and snap to a zero crossing; cc0_import already has a seamless path for music (ace_import) that can be reused. Add a seam check (|jump| < 0.02, head/tail RMS within 3 dB) to tools/sfx_audit.py for audio/amb beds.

title: Phone speakers hear almost nothing of wind_soft, lava, hearth, campfire, frogs, space: 84-99.7% of their energy is below 200 Hz
repro: FFT of decoded audio/amb beds: lava 99.7% <200 Hz (audible part at its -18 dB offset ~ -65 dBFS), wind_soft 97.8% (winter everywhere, 14 mega areas, windy maps: ~ -52 dBFS audible vs -35 on headphones), hearth 91%, frogs 86%, campfire 85%, space 84%. Tom plays only on a phone; phone speakers roll off below ~200-300 Hz, so winter wind, lava rifts, fireplaces and frog nights are near-silent there while birds/crickets/rain come through.
fix: At import (cc0_import.py bed path / make_ambience.py), high-pass beds at ~120-150 Hz and add a gentle presence shelf (1-4 kHz) so the texture survives phone speakers (wind: band-passed hiss/whistle layer; lava: bubbling/pop layer in 300 Hz-2 kHz; fire: crackle transients). Level-check by loudness above 200 Hz, not raw RMS. Optional: a Settings 'phone speaker' EQ on the Ambience bus.
audio_needed: Possibly new CC0 sources with mid/high content for wind (whistle/gust), lava (bubbling), fireplace crackle.

title: Bed volume offsets assume normalised sources but the files span 18 dB RMS: indoor rain_roof is louder than heavy rain outside; basement_drips/boiling/campfire are near-inaudible; MAX_BEDS trimming ranks by raw offset
repro: Effective level = file RMS + Ambience offset: rain_roof -34.8 vs rain_heavy outdoors -35.2 and rain_light -40.7; crowd -33.5 (louder than rain); basement_drips -52.2, boiling -51.6, campfire -49.8, rec_alley -50.5, crystal_hum -48.9 vs birds_day -45 and wind -35. The 'keep the loudest 4' trim (ambience.gd:261-267) compares offsets only, so a loud-file bed with a low offset can be kept over a quieter-file bed that is actually louder or more important.
fix: Loudness-normalise every audio/amb bed to one target (e.g. -24 LUFS, measured above 150 Hz) in sfx_soften.py/cc0_import.py, log it, then retune the dB offsets in ambience.gd so indoor rain < outdoor rain and drips/boiling/campfire are audible (about -18..-20 after normalising). Add a check in tools/sfx_audit.py that bed loudness is within +-2 LU of the target.

title: Fireplace crackle (hearth) plays in every interior on fall/winter days and every night: rec arcade, bank, clinic, chapel, school, library, store, smith
repro: ambience.gd:201-205: id in [house, interior] and (se in fall/winter or night) -> hearth -18, for any interior_id. In the Rec Center at night hearth (-18) outranks rec_alley (-22) and arcade_floor (-19) in the 4-bed trim, so an arcade gets a log-fire bed. Probe: in_rec 23:00 / winter / fall -> arcade_floor, hearth -18, rec_alley; in_bank winter noon -> hearth -18.
fix: Only add hearth for interiors that have a hearth: house and a HEARTH_ROOMS list (cottage_a/b/c, hazel_house, inn, lodge, mansion, moss_hut, tam_hut, river_hut, fishing_hut, sel_camp, lighthouse) or an interiors.json 'hearth': true flag (furnish.py knows if a fireplace prop is placed). Give shops/clinic/library/chapel a quiet room tone instead (planned in AUDIO-PLAN 6.3 'shop murmur, clinic quiet, chapel echo').
audio_needed: Room tones planned in AUDIO-PLAN 6.3 (shop murmur, chapel echo, library quiet) if not already sourced.

title: Night insects and frogs in winter: frog and insect spot rules have no season gate (lake/marsh/bog frogs every winter night; marsh/jungle insects all year, day and night)
repro: ambience.gd:342-347: frog spot for marsh/lake/bf_bog_crossing at dusk/night with no season or weather check (so also in snow/blizzard); insect spot for jungle/marsh with only `calm`. The frogs/crickets beds are gated to spring/summer(/fall) but the spots are not, so a winter night at the lake croaks every 6-16 s. Also penguin_chatter (line 333) plays in blizzards and at night with no outdoors check. The 'marsh' bed (swamp-environment atmosphere_1, a summer swamp recording) also plays all winter in marsh/bf_bog_crossing (probe: marsh day 94 = marsh -16 + wind_soft).
fix: frog spot: se in [spring, summer] (fall dusk at most) and not snowy; insect spot: se != winter (jungle region season is summer so unaffected) and ph != night unless crickets would play; penguin_chatter: calm and not night (or quieter at night). marsh bed: -8 dB and no insects in winter (or a winter bog bed: wind + ice creaks).

title: Spot sounds never use their second takes: spot_bird_chirp_2, cicada_2, drip_2, frog_2, gull_2, insect_2, wave_2 are shipped but unused
repro: Ambience._spot loads only res://audio/amb/spot_<name>.ogg / .wav (ambience.gd:365-367). The _2 files exist in audio/amb (CC0 imports with takes), so every drip in a mine or frog at the lake is the identical sample, unlike Music.sfx which picks a random take.
fix: In _spot, collect existing takes [spot_<n>, spot_<n>_2, spot_<n>_3] (.ogg then .wav, cached) and pick one at random; add pitch_scale randf_range(0.94, 1.06). Check sfx_audit.py still counts the _2 files as used.

title: Town chatter, festival crowd, rain-on-roof, leaves, lava, space and crystal hum are still synthesized placeholders (not in audio/amb/REAL.txt)
repro: REAL.txt lists 40 real names; town_day, crowd, rain_roof, leaves, lava, space, crystal_hum come from make_ambience.py (town_day/crowd = sine-modulated noise 'voices', space = 55 Hz tones, lava = sub-bass rumble). town_day plays every day in the Valley town and Gilt City; crowd at every festival/market/casino; rain_roof every rainy day indoors. AUDIO-PLAN 6.3 lists these as to be rebuilt.
fix: Source CC0 recordings (OpenGameArt/freesound CC0: market/town walla, festival crowd, rain on roof/window, leaves rustle in wind, lava bubbling, a soft space/air-hum pad or ACE drone per AUDIO-PLAN) via cc0_import.py MAP entries, add the names to REAL.txt, credit in docs/AUDIO-CREDITS.md.
audio_needed: CC0 beds: town walla (calm), festival crowd, rain on roof, wind-in-leaves, lava bubbling; ACE soft drones for space and crystal_hum (no melody).

title: Storms indoors sound the same as drizzle: rain_roof only, no thunder (Scenery only exists on sky maps), so a storm day in the house/shops loses its drama
repro: Day with weather storm, go into the house or any interior: ambience.gd:202-203 adds rain_roof -16 for rain and storm alike; thunder() is only called from Scenery lightning (scenery.gd:213), which interiors don't have.
fix: Indoors on storm days: rain_roof a few dB louder (or rain_heavy low-passed at -20) plus a muffled thunder spot (spot_thunder at -14 with pitch 0.85, every 20-50 s) from Ambience._spots when id in [house, interior] and GameState.weather_today() == 'storm'.

title: Music night/storm duck sticks during the Epilogue and while muted: _evaluate returns before set_duck
repro: ambience.gd:139-141 returns {} when Epilogue.showing or muted, before the duck logic at 269-276. If the ending starts outdoors at night (duck -4) or in a storm (-7), the credits/ending songs play 4-7 dB quiet for the whole epilogue.
fix: Before the early return call Music._inst.set_duck(0.0) (when valid), e.g. a small _set_duck(0.0) helper used in both paths.

title: Mega areas, battlefields and colonies have no spot layer: no drips in Frost Caverns' neighbours' regions, no owls in Gloamwood, no gulls at Windward, no distant clanks in Ironline; spot rules are keyed to Valley scene ids only
repro: ambience.gd:329-347 spot rules test fixed ids (OWL_MAPS, SEA_MAPS, marsh/lake, jungle...). Only is_cave() reaches mega caves (drip). Gloamwood (eternal dusk forest with fireflies) gets no owl/insect spots, gloam_moonpool no frog spots, Windward no gull/gust spots, Ironline/Gilt City no street/rail one-shots; a bed alone on loop is what the player hears for the whole area.
fix: Read an optional regions.json 'spots': [[spot, min_s, max_s, dB], ...] in _spots (gated by calm/phase like the built-ins) and have gen_mega_new.py / gen_battles.py write them (gloam: owl, insect, frog at moonpool; windward: gull; ironline: a train horn/clank spot if sourced; frost: drip in caverns already via cave).
audio_needed: Optional new spots: distant train horn/rail clank (Ironline), wind gust (Windward/Frostpeak).

title: City mega areas get countryside wildlife: birds_day and crickets on Gilt City's Casino Row and Ironline's Freight Yards/Junction/Mill District; casino row goes quieter at night
repro: Probe (tools/probe_c6_07_amb.gd, gangsters): gilt_casino_row day = birds_day -16 + crowd + neon_street + town_day; night = crickets -18, crowd -30, town_day -30. iron_freight_yards day birds_day, night crickets. CITY_MAPS (ambience.gd:26) only lists Valley/gang ids, so wildlife beds and the winter bird_chirp spot are added. No region uses amb_night, so the 'streets thin out' -10 dB rule makes a casino street quieter after dark, the opposite of the C4 design note.
fix: Treat region areas with theme.style city/chrome/clockwork (or an 'urban': true regions.json flag written by gen_mega_new.py for giltcity/ironline areas) like CITY_MAPS: no birds_day/crickets beds or bird_chirp spots (maybe a pigeon/sparrow spot later). Give gilt_casino_row an amb_night list (crowd -16, neon_street -13) in gen_mega_new.py.

title: Frogs croak at the saltwater docks/beach at night (frogs bed keys on any nearby water), and desert/frost region campfires crackle at noon
repro: Probe: docks d10 23:00 -> frogs -19 alongside waves (ambience.gd:167: near > 0.3, no SEA_MAPS exclusion). desert_mirage_post at 12:00 -> campfire -22 (region amb, no time gate); frost_hearthhold the same.
fix: Skip frogs on SEA_MAPS / maps with waves; in gen_mega_new.py move campfire to amb_night for mirage_post/hearthhold (or gate 'campfire' to dusk/night in ambience's region loop).

title: Spot one-shots jump 25-35 dB over the beds: owl, bird_chirp, gull, penguin chatter, rooster land near -12..-19 dBFS over a cricket/wind bed at -45..-48; spot_bird_chirp(_2) are normalised to 0 dBFS clicks
repro: Short-term (100 ms) loudness + Ambience offset: owl -12.4, bird_chirp_2 -14.3 (0.2 s at peak 0.0 dBFS), bird_chirp -17.2, gull -19, penguin_chatter -18.8, rooster -16.2, thunder -13.2; beds: crickets -47.7, birds_day -45, wind_soft (phone) -52. AudioStreamPlayer2D at 60-140 px of max_distance 400 only takes ~2-4 dB off. A quiet winter-day or summer-night soundscape gets a sudden loud chirp/hoot every 8-60 s; on a phone it reads as a pop.
fix: Normalise spot files to a common short-term level (e.g. -18 dBFS peak-ish / -24 LUFS-S) at import (cc0_import 'cap', sfx_soften for audio/amb/spot_*), then set spot offsets so they sit 6-10 dB above their bed (owl ~-26, bird_chirp ~-28, gull ~-26). Also set p.attenuation and a smaller max_distance so the 60-140 px offset gives real distance cues; add pitch_scale jitter.

title: The farm rooster is still a synthesized saw-wave sweep (only spot_rooster.wav from make_ambience.py), played every morning
repro: audio/amb has spot_rooster.wav only (make_ambience.py:231: three saw sweeps); not in REAL.txt, no CC0 .ogg. Ambience._spots plays it once each morning on the farm (ambience.gd:357-360) at -6 dB, one of the loudest ambience sounds and heard on day 1.
fix: Add a CC0 rooster crow to cc0_import.py MAP as spot 'rooster' (OpenGameArt/freesound CC0 farm-animal packs), level it with sfx_soften, list it in REAL.txt and AUDIO-CREDITS.md; drop its offset to about -12 after normalising.

title: No behavioural test of Ambience bed choice: caves, winter, battlefields and mega areas regress silently (sfx_audit only checks files exist; it also skips amb_day/amb_night keys)
repro: Only tools/mega_ui_test.gd touches Ambience (is_cave/is_quiet). Nothing asserts e.g. 'no wind/town/city bed in a cave', 'no crickets/frogs/birds in winter or at noon', 'bf_station_deck has no birds', 'lava bed on lava mine floors'. tools/sfx_audit.py:85-87 reads only regions.json 'amb', not 'amb_day'/'amb_night' or RecAudio.BEDS.
fix: Add tools/ambience_test.gd (headless, --fixed-fps 60) built like tools/probe_c6_07_amb.gd: load scenes, set day/time/weather, call Ambience._evaluate() and assert the rules above for frost_caverns, gilt_vaults, iron_tunnels, gloam_moonpool (winter/noon), bf_station_deck, bf_sewer_works, mine with a lava theme, in_rec (no hearth). Wire it into check.sh as its own block; extend sfx_audit to amb_day/amb_night.

title: Forest fall 'leaves' bed runs at night and under rain/snow; wind_soft runs at one level all winter day and night in every Valley map
repro: ambience.gd:185-186 adds leaves -18 for any fall forest visit regardless of phase/weather (stacks under rain_heavy). ambience.gd:169-170 gives wind_soft -14 to every outdoor map all winter; with only wind on a winter night the farm/town/lake all sound identical.
fix: leaves: skip when wet/snowy, -6 dB at night. Winter wind: vary by place (-12 open maps: mountain/meadow/beach; -18 sheltered: town/forest) and time (gustier by day), and add the owl/hearth-chimney life instead of one flat bed.

title: Festival-night campfire crackles in the rain while the festival crowd bed is muted by rain
repro: Probe: town day 70 (Harvest Fair, fall 14) 23:00 rain -> campfire -20 + rain_light; crowd is skipped (ambience.gd:187 'not wet') but the festival campfire (ambience.gd:229-230) has no wet check. Also the crowd stops at 23:00 sharp with no taper.
fix: Gate the festival campfire on not wet (or swap to a covered-stall murmur); taper crowd from 22:00 to 23:00 (-14 -> -24) instead of a hard cut.
